The Topology Boundary Auditor's high confidence score (0.97) is misleading here—it confirms the mask is contiguous, but does not refute the physical impossibility of the axle connection noted by the Router. The Geometric Depth Auditor's data supports the spatial layout but cannot detect the fine-grained mechanical fusion.
